name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly after a career in law enforcement. Following a high-profile case involving race-fixing, she was recruited by a smaller racing team to overhaul their security protocols. Her pragmatic approach, honed through years of police work, quickly proved invaluable. She excels at identifying potential vulnerabilities and implementing robust countermeasures. 

At EVO Racing Team, Isabelle brings a calm and methodical presence. She emphasizes preventative measures and thorough risk assessments, ensuring that every aspect of the team's operations, from transportation to data security, is protected. Her colleagues appreciate her no-nonsense attitude and dedication to maintaining a secure environment, allowing the team to focus on performance.

physical.description: A stern woman with a commanding presence, standing tall at 5'10" with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn book of security protocols.
Insists on conducting random security drills at unexpected times.
Has a remarkable ability to remember faces and associate them with potential threats.
